description: Compute US federal quarterly estimated tax payments (Form 1040-ES) for self-employed people and people with side income. Four modes: catch_up (behind on this year's payments: what is owed and what to pay by the next due date), set_aside (W-2 job plus side business: share of side profit to set aside), safe_harbor (the prior-year 100% or 110% safe harbor that avoids the underpayment penalty), required (the required annual payment and per-quarter amount). Returns figures, due dates, official sources and the tax year used.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately) or hoh (head of household). Default single.

mode.description: catch_up: self-employed and behind on this year's estimated payments (needs profit, optional paid_so_far). set_aside: a W-2 job plus a side business, what share of side profit to set aside (needs profit and w2_wages). safe_harbor: the prior-year safe harbor that avoids the underpayment penalty (needs prior_year_tax and prior_year_agi, optional withholding and side_profit). required: the Form 1040-ES required annual payment and per-quarter amount (needs profit, optional w2_wages, withholding, prior_year_tax, prior_year_agi).

paid_so_far.description: catch_up: estimated payments already made for the year, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

prior_year_agi.description: Last year's adjusted gross income, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

prior_year_tax.description: Last year's total tax (Form 1040 total tax line), in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

profit.description: Expected self-employment profit for the year, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

side_profit.description: safe_harbor: this year's side-business profit, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

tax_year.description: The tax year the figures are for (2025, 2026, 2027). Leave it out for the default: last year's return until April 15, then the current year.

w2_wages.description: W-2 wages from a job for the year, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

withholding.description: This year's federal income tax withholding from a job, in US dollars (whole dollars, no symbols)

name: quarterly_estimate
title: Quarterly estimated tax
